name: Omen Exitio: Hunger
source:
The events told in Omen Exitio: Hunger start from real events set within an extremely accurate historical framework, all draped in a typically Lovecraftian atmosphere.

On February 11, 1927, a little boy named Billy Gaffney mysteriously disappeared from his apartment in Brooklyn. The town is turned upside down by the authorities and the many volunteers who try to help, but there is no clue about the little boy. Only your intervention could shed some light on this drama.

Through a cinematic and engaging narrative, you will have to exploit your skills as a reporter and your keen powers of observation to search for clues and interrogate suspects. But your talents alone will not be enough.
To get closer and closer to the truth, you may have to visit other worlds, interpret your dreams, and sometimes listen to your cat. We still don't know what lies beneath that macabre veil that has dropped over the city. Perhaps nothing but horror awaits us.

Be very careful about the choices you decide to make: your actions are limited, and you will have to make crucial decisions. What will you be willing to sacrifice for the discovery of the truth?

Omen Exitio: Hunger is a story of ordinary people discovering how adventure and horror are inherent in everyday life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《崩坏之兆：饥荒》从真实事件出发，在严谨考据的历史背景上，笼上一层典型的洛夫克拉夫特式阴影。

1927年2月11日，名叫比利·加夫尼的小男孩在布鲁克林的公寓里神秘失踪。警方和大批志愿者把当地翻了个底朝天，仍找不到丝毫线索。只有你的介入，才可能为这桩悲剧带来一线光亮。

在富有电影感的叙事中，你要发挥记者的本领和敏锐的观察力，搜寻线索，盘问嫌疑人。可光凭这些本事还不够。
为了进一步逼近真相，你也许得造访其他世界，解读自己的梦，有时还得听听自家猫的意见。那道笼罩城市的可怕帷幕之下，究竟藏着什么，谁也不知道。也许在等着我们的，只有恐怖。

你的行动次数有限，有些决定又至关重要，每次选择都要仔细掂量。为了查明真相，你愿意牺牲什么？

《崩坏之兆：饥荒》讲述的是普通人的故事。他们逐渐发现，冒险与恐怖原本就藏在日常生活之中。
